description: This file defines a plugin for Slate editor to manage 'insertMenu' marks, including functions to find paths with insertMenu, remove insertMenu marks outside of selection, and enhance the editor with insertMenu behavior.

methods.name: findPathWithInsertMenu
methods.description: Recursively searches for a path in the node tree where insertMenu is present.

methods.name: removeInsertMenuMarkWhenOutsideOfSelection
methods.description: Removes insertMenu mark from the node at the found path if the selection is outside that path.

methods.name: withInsertMenu
methods.description: Enhances the Slate editor with insertMenu handling, including normalization, applying operations, and inserting text with insertMenu logic.
